subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should answer-candidate lifecycle entries land now as a focused Activity slice of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039, or should this branch be folded into a broader native Codex progress design?
rationale: The patch has a coherent user value, but current main changed the Activity ownership path and the broader issue is already labeled for maintainer product review.

options.title: Retarget as focused Activity slice
options.body: Ask for a rebase that ports this behavior to `ui/src/pages/activity/*`, then review it as the answer-candidate portion of the native Codex progress issue.

options.title: Fold into broader progress work
options.body: Keep this PR open only as context and have a canonical Codex progress implementation absorb the answer-candidate lifecycle.

options.title: Reject this Activity surface
options.body: Close the PR only if maintainers decide answer-candidate lifecycle entries should not be a Control UI Activity concept.

recommendation.title: Retarget as focused Activity slice
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase that ports this behavior to `ui/src/pages/activity/*`, then review it as the answer-candidate portion of the native Codex progress issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about Codex runtime UX/product direction, and this owner has recent adjacent Codex projector and Control UI stream history.
